description: A very tough fibrous paper, despite the name, prized for its strength. The thinnest grades serve to mend the backs of split sections, reinforce weak spots in a leaf, and repair vellum-bound volumes.
name: Japanese vellum

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter XX, p.280. Internet Archive.
